summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long Memory Daily ETF (RAML) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is actively managed, aiming to provide daily 2x leveraged exposure to the price performance of Roundhill Memory ETF (CBOE: DRAM), less fees, and expenses. DRAM is an actively managed ETF, providing exposure to global equity securities of memory companies RAML was launched on Jul 23, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
